name: Segorbe (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the arms of Segorbe: a yellow castle surmounted by a guardian angel and flanked by two yellow letters F, with the motto on a scroll beneath.
history: The flag was approved on 19 December 2000 and is described as a flag of 2:3, crimson red, with at the centre the same arms as the shield: a castle or masoned sable surmounted by a guardian angel and flanked by two letters F of or, with the legend on a scroll.
